title: Bee Removal in Somers, NY
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in Somers, Westchester. Wall-void, attic, and ground nest treatment. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nest removal throughout Somers, NY. An active nest in a wall void, attic, soffit, or eave is a structural problem that grows worse the longer it's left alone. Our licensed technicians locate the nest, treat it, remove accessible material, and seal every entry point to prevent recolonization — protecting Somers homes and businesses from stinging-insect pressure that won't resolve on its own.
whyUs: Our Somers bee removal specialists combine over 15 years of experience with humane removal techniques that relocate bees whenever possible. We serve all of Somers, from historic properties near Lasdon Park to rural estates and suburban neighborhoods, with transparent pricing and guaranteed results.
localContext: Somers' blend of wooded properties, historic homes, and proximity to natural areas like Muscoot Reservoir creates ideal habitats for wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket nests in attics, wall voids, soffits, and tree cavities. The town's many older structures and expansive yards mean paper nests can grow undetected inside wall cavities until defend-the-nest behavior begins. Carpenter bees bore into exposed fascia and trim, and ground-nesting yellow jackets colonize lawn edges and landscaping beds — conditions that require experienced professionals who understand both structural nest removal and the unique characteristics of Westchester properties.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Somers property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service in Somers for most situations. Nests inside living spaces or aggressive colonies defending an entry point are prioritized. After your call, we typically arrive within 2–4 hours to assess the nest location and species, and we can often complete treatment and entry-point sealing during the first visit, depending on nest location and access.

faqs.question: What does bee and wasp removal cost in Somers?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Somers?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or yellow jackets return after nest removal from my Somers home?
faqs.answer: Our service includes nest treatment, removal of accessible nest material, and sealing every entry point the colony used — which eliminates the pheromone trail and physical access that would allow recolonization. We provide recommendations for additional exclusion work where needed. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
